caption_en: 57 countries have English as an official language. Israel isn't one of them.
caption_he:
ב-57 מדינות אנגלית היא שפה רשמית. ישראל לא אחת מהן. 🌍

ארה"ב, בריטניה, קנדה, אוסטרליה, הודו (כמעט מיליארד וחצי אנשים), פקיסטן, ניגריה, הפיליפינים, סינגפור, קניה, דרום אפריקה, אירלנד, מלטה ועוד.
בישראל אנגלית היא שפת עבודה, לא שפה רשמית. אבל תיכנסו לפגישה בכל אחת מ-57 המדינות האלה, והיא תתנהל באנגלית.

אנגלית היא לא המטרה. היא הדרך לעסקה.

שלחו למישהו שטס לפגישה בחו"ל.

מקור: Wikipedia, List of countries and territories where English is an official language (2026).

lines.line: Fifty seven countries have English as an official language. Is Israel one of them?
India, almost one and a half billion people.
Singapore. Kenya. South Africa. Ireland. Malta.
And Israel? Not one of them.
Here, English is a working language, not an official one.
But walk into a meeting in any of those fifty seven, and it runs in English.
English isn't the goal. It's the road to the deal.
So before your next meeting abroad, ask yourself:

transcript.heard: 57 countries have English as an official language. Is Israel one of them? Watch the map fill. America. Britain. Canada. Australia. India almost one and a half billion people. Pakistan. Nigeria. The Philippines. Singapore. Kenya. South Africa. Ireland. Malta. 57 countries in all. And Israel. Not one of them. Here, English is a working language. an official one. But walk into a meeting in any of those 57 and it runs in English. English isn't the goal. It's the road to the deal. So before your next meeting abroad, ask yourself.
